column1: # Brand / product names: spoken form (as a Turkish recognizer emits it) → written form with official casing.
# Multiple spoken variants per brand are fine. Inside an e-mail address the e-mail grammar wins, so "gmail"
# stays lower-case there and becomes "Gmail" only as a free-standing word.
# --- Turkish companies / banks / telecom / retail / travel
# car models read letter + number (Hyundai i yirmi -> i20); only multi-word spoken forms, so a bare letter is never touched
# --- more ASR mis-hearings (social / productivity / dev / payments / retail)
